_comment: AI enrichment endpoint. Any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint works.
Environment variables override every value here: LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_MODEL, LLM_API_KEY.
Never put an API key in this file - it is tracked by git. Keys are read from
the environment only. Use LLM_API_KEY, or a .env file (already gitignored).
See 'presets' below for common endpoints, including local servers that keep
your RBAC data on your own network.
_pricing_comment: Optional. USD per million tokens, keyed by model name. Used only to show a
cost estimate before sending. Omit a model and the tool reports no cost
estimate rather than inventing one - which is the correct answer for a local
_presets_comment: Reference only - the tool does not read this block. Copy a base_url and model
up into the fields above, or export the environment variables.

openrouter.note: Hosted. Your RBAC data is sent to OpenRouter and the upstream model provider.

ollama.note: Local. Data stays on your machine. Run: ollama serve

lm-studio.note: Local. Data stays on your machine. Start the server from the LM Studio Developer tab.
